name: Cura
subtitle: AI-Powered Travel-Tech Platform (India & US)
challenge: Cura launched its customer acquisition campaign on October 28, 2026. Initial aggregate metrics hovered at an expensive ₹278 Cost Per Result (CPR) with low conversion velocity (3.9 daily signups) due to underperforming broad US ad sets, fatigued static creatives, and ad spend cannibalization across weak variants.
approach: Campaign Launch Diagnostics: Analyzed first 7 days of campaign delivery across India and US ad sets to pinpoint budget bleeding.
Aggressive Ad Set Trimming: Paused the underperforming US ad set (which burned ₹1,587 CPR) and underperforming static ads (10TABS_STATIC_1X1, DUBAI_SINGAPORE_STATIC).

Capital Consolidation: Shifted 100% of the active budget into the highest-performing geographic cohorts: Bangalore-Hyderabad tech early adopters (IN_AS02: ₹133.92 CPR) and Mumbai-Delhi luxury leisure planners (IN_AS01: ₹208.67 CPR).

Daily Creative Iteration Loop: Deployed high-converting UGC reels and engineer walkthroughs (CURA_IN_CONCERT_TRIP_UGC_REEL_V1, CURA_IN_ENGINEER_EXPLAINS_REEL_V2, and CURA_IN_AD03_ITALY_7DAYS_REEL_V1).
Dual Funnel Optimization: Balanced website signups (CURA_M1_IN_C01_SIGNUP_WEB) with direct app store acquisition (CURA_IN_C02_APPCLICK_ANDROID and C03_APPCLICK_IOS).
result: Drove a massive 185% surge in daily results (from 3.9 to 11.0 daily verified registrations) while slashing Cost Per Result by 46% (from ₹278 down to ₹149 blended, with winning ad sets hitting ₹108.77 CPR). Generated 143+ verified conversions across web and app with ₹13.4L+ in initiated checkout pipeline value.

strategies.title: 01 AD SET PRUNING & CAPITAL REALLOCATION
strategies.description: Identified high CPR drag in the US prospecting ad set (burning ₹1,587 per signup). Paused it immediately and reallocated 100% of the active budget to high-velocity domestic corridors (Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi).

strategies.title: 02 DAILY CREATIVE TESTING & UGC REEL VELOCITY
strategies.description: Implemented a rapid daily creative iteration system testing relatable concert trips, engineer walkthroughs, and destination budget itineraries against static banners. UGC Reels out-converted static by 3.2x.

strategies.title: 03 CITY-LEVEL SEGMENTATION & INTENT HOOKS
strategies.description: Split audiences into tech-driven efficiency planners (Bengaluru & Hyderabad at ₹133.92 CPR) vs curated international luxury vacationers (Mumbai & Delhi at ₹208.67 CPR) with localized route messaging.

strategies.title: 04 SERVER-SIDE CAPI & DUAL-FUNNEL CONVERSION
strategies.description: Integrated Meta Conversion API with 7-day click, 1-day view attribution. Deduplicated web signups and scaled app store acquisition channels in tandem to feed Meta's machine learning algorithm.

snapshots.caption: Top Volume Creative: 32 Website Registrations (₹132.22 CPR) + 24 App Store Clicks (₹125.12 CPR). 26,631 Impressions, 1.88% Link CTR. Rated Above Average across Quality, Engagement, and Conversion Rankings.
snapshots.note: Authentic UGC concert-trip narrative hooked high-intent millennial and Gen-Z travelers planning weekend festival getaways.

snapshots.campaignName: Breakout: Engineer Explains Cura Itinerary Engine (CURA_IN_ENGINEER_EXPLAINS_REEL_V2)
snapshots.caption: Breakout Efficiency: ₹108.77 Cost Per Registration! Generated 27 Registrations and 15 Initiated Checkouts with ₹8,27,276 in conversion value. 3.65% Total CTR with Above Average Quality & Conversion.
snapshots.note: Product-first demonstration showing the exact step-by-step itinerary creation UI resolved trust barriers and drove peak conversion value.

snapshots.campaignName: HNW Performer: 7 Days in Italy Curated Route (CURA_IN_AD03_ITALY_7DAYS_REEL_V1)
snapshots.caption: Luxury & Long-Haul Performer: 15 Registrations (₹151.53 CPR), ₹30,107 conversion value, 8,089 Impressions. Above Average Quality & Conversion Rate.
snapshots.note: Specific aspirational route targeting international travelers planning European vacations with transparent day-by-day budget estimates.

snapshots.campaignName: Contrast Angle: Life With vs Without Cura (CURA_IN_WITH_WITHOUT_UGC_REEL_V1)
snapshots.caption: Pain-Point Visualizer: 10 Registrations (₹199.88 CPR). Visually contrasted managing 10 open browser tabs vs having one cohesive, shareable Cura itinerary.
snapshots.note: Direct pain-point creative targeting tab-overload fatigue among independent trip planners.

timeline.title: Campaign Launch & Baseline Diagnostics (28th Oct)
timeline.description: Launched initial campaign across India (BLR, HYD, MUM, DEL) and US (NYC, LA, CHI). Initial baseline recorded 3.9 daily results at an expensive ₹278 CPR.

timeline.title: Ad Set Pruning & Budget Reallocation (1st Nov)
timeline.description: Identified US ad set dragging metrics at ₹1,587 CPR and static ads yielding low engagement. Paused weak variants immediately and shifted capital into India top performers.

timeline.title: Daily UGC & Reel Creative Rotation (5th Nov)
timeline.description: Deployed authentic concert trips, engineer walkthroughs, and 7-day Italy itineraries. High-converting video reels reduced cost per click by 42%.

timeline.title: Peak Scale & +185% Result Surge (15th Nov)
timeline.description: Daily results surged by 185% to 11.0 results/day. Blended CPR dropped 46% to ₹149. Winning reel (Engineer Explains) hit ₹108 CPR with ₹8.27L+ in checkout value.

keyLearnings: UGC & Engineer Walkthroughs Outperform Static Ads: Authentic Reels drove over 80% of all registrations at 40% lower CPR compared to static 1x1 image ads.
City Cohort Specialization: Tech early adopters in Bengaluru and Hyderabad convert at ₹133 CPR for AI trip tools, while Mumbai and Delhi require luxury/international destination proof (₹208 CPR).
Rapid Kill-Criteria for Bleeding Audiences: Pausing the US ad set saved ₹4,700+ that was re-invested to capture 35+ incremental Indian signups.
Full-Funnel Value Velocity: Beyond registrations, winning creatives drove 34 checkouts with over ₹13.4L in initiated checkout transaction value.

provenance.source: Meta Ads Manager Active Diagnostic Export (Report Period: Oct 25, 2026 – Nov 25, 2026)
